author: michaelkrymski
summary: Record actual real-depth phone to Pi transport and reconnect
details: Phone sent and Pi operator reported receiving 80 real depth packets across two connections, strict sequence/capture order, ~9.07 Hz. Eight correlated clock exchanges recorded as diagnostics; age eligibility remains unknown. No GPIO, guidance or electrical acceptance.
validation: Signed physical iPhone paired test: 1 passed, 0 failed/skipped. Receiver summary operator-reported. No implementation change; shared checks via checked publisher.
